newForms.name: Silkfen
newForms.lore: Strings silk between marsh reeds so fine that fireflies mistake it for starlight.

newForms.name: Duskweaver
newForms.lore: Weaves at dusk only; unravel one thread and the whole web hums a warning.

newForms.name: Nightloom
newForms.lore: Its web spans the whole hollow now, and everything caught in it dreams the same dream.

newForms.name: Fatewoven
newForms.lore: Marsh elders say it doesn't catch prey — it catches the moment prey was always going to wander in.

newForms.name: Rattlecap
newForms.lore: Learned to bounce off gravestones for extra echo. The graveyard now has excellent acoustics.

newForms.name: Jawknell
newForms.lore: Its jaw unhinges to ring like a bell; three rings means run.

newForms.name: Direknell
newForms.lore: Leads a whole chorus of clattering bones through the marsh at midnight.

newForms.name: Grimcrown
newForms.lore: Wears the jawbones of every skull that ever tried to out-rattle it, like a crown.

newForms.name: Lampmaw
newForms.lore: Swallowed a whole lantern once. Still hasn't worked out how to put it down.

newForms.name: Moonmaw
newForms.lore: Waits under bridges on full-moon nights for wayfarers who forgot to bring a light of their own.

newForms.name: Duskgorge
newForms.lore: Every lantern in Mistveil Marsh is lit a little dimmer, because this is where the missing light goes.

newForms.name: Glimmerkoi
newForms.lore: Leaps highest at twilight, just to see how many colours it can catch on its scales at once.

newForms.name: Astralkoi
newForms.lore: Local Wayfarers swear it swims in slow circles that trace the constellations overhead.

newForms.name: Mirrorwyrm
newForms.lore: A river spirit grown long as the lake is wide; the stars it mirrors are the same ones that named it.

newForms.name: Cinderkoi
newForms.lore: Swims lava seams like rivers; the water-koi it left behind still don't believe the stories.

newForms.name: Pyrokoi
newForms.lore: Leaves a trail of glassy, cooled scale-flakes wherever it surfaces from the magma.

newForms.name: Magmawyrm
newForms.lore: A river of molten gold given the shape of a dragon-koi; the Scar's deepest vents are just where it exhales.

newForms.name: Solscale
newForms.lore: Basks so long in one spot that Wayfarers use it to tell the time of day.

newForms.name: Coronafin
newForms.lore: Its fin-shadow alone is enough to cool a whole stretch of lake on the hottest afternoon.

newForms.name: Sovereignsun
newForms.lore: Elder Wayfarers say the lake has two suns on the brightest days, and only one of them sets.

newForms.name: Ripjaw
newForms.lore: Its grin got a second row of teeth. Nobody has asked why.

newForms.name: Direfin
newForms.lore: Leads hunting packs of lesser sharks by grinning first and explaining never.

newForms.name: Leviagrin
newForms.lore: The old lake-captains say something the size of a fishing boat still grins back from the deep, and it is always, always hungry.

newForms.name: Duskangler
newForms.lore: Its lure burns a little brighter now, and a little more curious things go looking for it.

newForms.name: Gloomlure
newForms.lore: Anchors itself to sunken driftwood and waits so still that its lure becomes the only light for miles.

newForms.name: Abysslure
newForms.lore: Deep lake fishers have a rule: if the light down there is moving toward you, reel in and go home.

newForms.name: Voidmaw
newForms.lore: The oldest thing in the deepest lake. Its lure hasn't gone out in longer than anyone can remember.

newForms.name: Springjaw
newForms.lore: Its jaw-hinge got a little faster. The 'stuck drawer' sound is now a 'mousetrap' sound.

newForms.name: Vaultjaw
newForms.lore: Clamps down so hard that local Wayfarers use its old, shed teeth as boat anchors.

newForms.name: Clampfiend
newForms.lore: Nothing that gets caught in that jaw tells the story twice.

newForms.name: Doomlatch
newForms.lore: The deepest trench in Mirror Lakes has a name, and the name is a warning about what's down there waiting with its jaw cocked.

prompts.name: Weblin
prompts.prompt: A small round spider with eight glinting violet eyes and thin glassy legs, spinning a web that shimmers faintly with caught dewdrops; dark plum body with pale lilac joints.

prompts.name: Silkfen
prompts.prompt: Grows a second row of eyes and longer, silk-draped legs trailing loose threads like ribbons; same plum-and-lilac colouring, now with faint glowing thread patterns along its back.

prompts.name: Duskweaver
prompts.prompt: A broader abdomen patterned like a woven web, with glowing violet thread-lines pulsing along each leg; the same many-eyed face, now framed by a ruff of spun silk.

prompts.name: Nightloom
prompts.prompt: Looms over its own web platform on long, elegant legs, trailing veils of silk like a gown; deep violet body glows faintly at every joint where thread meets chitin.

prompts.name: Fatewoven
prompts.prompt: A majestic web-matriarch with an ornate crown of spun silk and glowing thread-patterns forming constellations across its abdomen; the same ancient many-eyed gaze, now serene and vast, ruling a web the size of a hollow.

prompts.name: Skullbop
prompts.prompt: A small bouncing skull with hollow violet-glowing eye sockets and a chattering jaw, chipped ivory-white bone with faint moss stains.

prompts.name: Rattlecap
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger skull now trailing a wisp of dark smoke beneath its jaw, ivory bone deepening toward grey, eye-glow a touch brighter violet.

prompts.name: Jawknell
prompts.prompt: Its jaw has grown an extra hinge and small bone spurs ring its crown like a jester's cap; smoky wisps thicken into a trailing tail.

prompts.name: Direknell
prompts.prompt: A cluster of smaller rattling bone-shards now orbits its skull, jaw wide and ornate with carved grooves that glow violet when it chatters.

prompts.name: Grimcrown
prompts.prompt: A towering ceremonial skull crowned with interlocking jawbones and a swirling cloak of violet smoke, eye sockets blazing like twin lanterns over the whole graveyard.

prompts.name: Blorp
prompts.prompt: A squat, bulging purple slime with a wide gummy grin and two stubby horn-nubs, faintly glowing veins running through its jelly body.

prompts.name: Gobblorp
prompts.prompt: A bigger slime with two curling horns and a wide lantern-swallowing jaw, deep violet body glowing brighter along its veins, faint magenta glow around its grin.

prompts.name: Lampmaw
prompts.prompt: A taller slime now with three curling horns and a permanently open jaw ringed in tiny lantern-flame lights it's swallowed, deepening violet jelly with brighter magenta veins.

prompts.name: Moonmaw
prompts.prompt: Looms wide and toothy with a crescent-shaped horn crown and a chest full of dimly glowing swallowed lanterns visible through translucent jelly.

prompts.name: Duskgorge
prompts.prompt: An enormous, regal slime sovereign whose whole body is a lantern-lit night sky under violet jelly skin, crowned in branching horns and trailing wisps of stolen light.

prompts.name: Gildfin
prompts.prompt: A small round goldfish with stubby fins and huge round eyes, bright orange-gold scales with a faint shimmer.

prompts.name: Mirrorscale
prompts.prompt: A sleek koi with flowing fins and pearlescent scales that catch the sky's colours, gold fading into soft blue along its back.

prompts.name: Glimmerkoi
prompts.prompt: Longer and more elegant with trailing ribbon fins, scales shifting from gold to silvery-blue and catching glints of light like a mirror in motion.

prompts.name: Astralkoi
prompts.prompt: A graceful, elongating koi whose fins trail like comet tails and whose pale blue scales now hold faint star-like sparkle points.

prompts.name: Mirrorwyrm
prompts.prompt: A majestic serpentine koi-dragon with flowing starlit fins and scales like liquid moonlight, its long body arcing through the air trailing a faint galaxy-glow.

prompts.name: Gildfin
prompts.prompt: A small round goldfish with stubby fins and huge round eyes, bright orange-gold scales with a faint shimmer.

prompts.name: Magmascale
prompts.prompt: A koi wreathed in heat-shimmer, orange-red scales glowing at the edges like cooling lava, fins trailing faint embers.

prompts.name: Cinderkoi
prompts.prompt: A longer, more muscular lava-koi with cracked-magma scale patterns glowing brighter at the seams, fins now edged in true flame.

prompts.name: Pyrokoi
prompts.prompt: An imposing fire-koi whose whole spine glows like a lava seam, trailing streams of drifting cinders from every fin.

prompts.name: Magmawyrm
prompts.prompt: A colossal molten dragon-koi, scales like cooling obsidian veined with glowing gold, its mane and fins a constant wreath of rolling flame.

prompts.name: Quillpuff
prompts.prompt: A small round puffed-up fish covered in soft spines, pale blue-white body with a worried, wide-eyed expression.

prompts.name: Sunbasker
prompts.prompt: A huge flat sunfish drifting sideways at the surface, pale gold-cream body with soft blue fin edges and a serene half-lidded expression, small birds perched along its back.

prompts.name: Solscale
prompts.prompt: A broader, more radiant sunfish with a faint golden sheen spreading across its pale body and brighter blue-gold fin edges, still drifting serenely at the surface.

prompts.name: Coronafin
prompts.prompt: A grand golden sunfish whose fin-edges now flare like solar rays, pale cream body glowing faintly warm, its half-lidded eyes calm as still water.

prompts.name: Sovereignsun
prompts.prompt: An immense radiant sunfish crowned in flaring golden fin-rays like a corona, glowing softly gold all over with serene half-lidded eyes; where it surfaces, the whole lake seems to shine.

prompts.name: Chompsy
prompts.prompt: A small fierce piranha with an oversized toothy grin and bright red-orange scales, fins flared aggressively.

prompts.name: Grinfin
prompts.prompt: A sleek grey-blue shark with a permanent wide grin full of teeth, powerful fins and a confident, predatory glide.

prompts.name: Ripjaw
prompts.prompt: A bulkier shark with a jagged double row of teeth and battle-scarred fins, grey-blue skin deepening toward a colder slate tone.

prompts.name: Direfin
prompts.prompt: A broad-shouldered apex shark with reinforced ridged fins and rows of glinting teeth, its slate-blue hide darkening with faint predatory markings.

prompts.name: Leviagrin
prompts.prompt: A colossal ancient leviathan shark, its cavernous grin ringed in glowing teeth and its dark, storm-blue hide scarred like a warship's hull, trailing a wake wherever it turns.

prompts.name: Lanterngulp
prompts.prompt: A round, dark anglerfish with a huge toothy grin and a tiny glowing lure dangling above its head, deep violet-black body with faint star-like speckles.

prompts.name: Duskangler
prompts.prompt: A slightly longer anglerfish with a brighter, warmer lure-glow and small fin-spines, its violet-black hide now flecked with faint constellations.

prompts.name: Gloomlure
prompts.prompt: A broader, more patient-looking anglerfish with a longer glowing lure-stalk and ridged fins, deep indigo body dotted with soft starlight speckles.

prompts.name: Abysslure
prompts.prompt: A large, imposing anglerfish with an ornate branching lure crowned in warm light and heavier armoured fins, near-black body glittering like a night sky.

prompts.name: Voidmaw
prompts.prompt: A massive ancient anglerfish sovereign of the deep, its huge crowned lure blazing like a captive star above a cavernous jaw, body a void-black expanse glittering with true constellations.

prompts.name: Hobsnap
prompts.prompt: A dark, sleek goblin shark with a long flattened snout and a jaw that juts forward on display, deep violet-grey hide with faint glowing gill-markings.

prompts.name: Springjaw
prompts.prompt: A slightly bulkier goblin shark whose jaw now snaps forward with visible mechanical speed, hide deepening toward indigo with brighter glowing gill-lines.

prompts.name: Vaultjaw
prompts.prompt: A broader, more armoured goblin shark with reinforced jaw-plates and longer fins, deep indigo-violet skin marked with glowing amber gill-streaks.

prompts.name: Clampfiend
prompts.prompt: A heavily built predator shark whose jaw has grown segmented, trap-like plating, its near-black hide glowing amber along every fin edge and gill slit.

prompts.name: Doomlatch
prompts.prompt: A colossal ancient goblin shark whose crowned, segmented jaw looks forged rather than grown, void-black hide blazing with amber glow-lines like a living machine of the deep.
